description: An unverified eGFR: status 'preliminary'. Declared source-only. This is the boundary case for R3's answer: 'amended' and 'corrected' became eligible because they are points on the REVISION axis - the result is complete and verified, and has since been revised. 'preliminary' is a point on the VERIFICATION axis: the result is not verified at all. Widening the eligible set must not widen it along the wrong axis, and without this fixture a suite that only shows 'final' mapping would not notice if it had.

expected.axis_note: registered, cancelled and unknown share this outcome and this reasoning. They get no fixture of their own; tests/contracts/ingest/test_eligibility.py::TestEveryObservationStatus drives all eight R4 statuses through ingestion and asserts the manifest outcome for each, which covers them without fixture bloat.
